parsed.post: Kept latest: 0.8637 -> 0.8616. LR/warmup gains look flattening, so I will test capacity next. Next single variable: ASPECT_RATIO 48 -> 64 with depth 4, batch 262144, shards 0-10. Watching params and time since larger width may trade optimizer steps for capacity.
parsed.description: Increase model capacity via ASPECT_RATIO 48 -> 64 on the latest kept base to test whether additional width improves val_bpb compared to further LR tuning.
